QQQ.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (unofficial provider client)

interpretation.text:
On 2026-11-06, QQQ’s 252-observation DFA H was 0.520, slightly above the ideal independent, finite-variance returns reference of 0.5. R²=0.980 indicates close fit over the 12 supplied scales, 8–63 observations, only. H rose 0.0135/0.0445 over 1/5 observations. Its prior-only, 30-estimate standardized deviation was +2.70; overlapping windows make this no significance test.

Hill alpha was 3.300 over 1,000 observations, using k=100 and x_min=0.019899 absolute log-return units. Given a suitable tail model, lower alpha suggests heavier fitted absolute-return tails; higher suggests thinner tails. Using 5%/15% cutoffs gave 3.591/3.080: sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

H/alpha moved from 0.476/3.309 on 2026-10-30 to 0.507/3.198 on 2026-11-05, then 0.520/3.300. Rolling-window entry/exit and threshold changes can affect alpha. These are uncertain descriptive estimates, not a crash forecast.
